posts.org: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways

posts.qualification: Diploma/Degree in relevant Engineering / Chemistry / Metallurgy disciplines
posts.desc: Railway Recruitment Boards have released CEN No. 04/2026 for 4,098 Junior Engineer, Depot Material Superintendent and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant posts. Apply online from 14 August to 13 September 2026.
details: Pay Level: Level-6 (7th CPC) with initial pay ₹35,400/-
Age relaxation as per Government rules for reserved categories
Post-wise vacancy split: JE (4,098), DMS & CMA as per notification

sections.h2: How to Apply for RRB JE 2026
paras: The application process is fully online. Candidates must register on the official RRB application portal before the closing date.
list: Visit the official RRB website rrbapply.gov.in
Open the RRB JE CEN 04/2026 recruitment section
Complete online registration and fill the form
Submit and save a printout for reference

faqs.q: What is the total vacancy for RRB JE 2026?
faqs.a: A total of 4,098 posts have been notified under CEN 04/2026, covering Junior Engineer, DMS and CMA posts across Indian Railways zones.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for RRB JE?
faqs.a: The age limit is 18 to 33 years as of the notification date, with relaxation for reserved categories per government rules.

faqs.q: What is the RRB JE selection process?
faqs.a: Selection involves a Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination.

posts.title: UP Scholarship 2026-27 — Online Application (Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, Top Class)
posts.org: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
posts.desc: UP Scholarship 2026-27 online applications for Pre-Matric, Post-Matric and Top Class scholarships. Apply on the official National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
details: Portal: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) — official government portal
Covers Pre-Matric (Class 9-10), Post-Matric (Class 11 onwards) and Top Class schemes
Scholarships are merit-cum-means based as per scheme guidelines
Fresh applications open every year after state notification; renewal for continuing students

paras: The UP Scholarship portal handles multiple schemes: Pre-Matric for Class 9-10, Post-Matric for Class 11 and above, and Top Class for Class 9-10 in top institutions.

faqs.q: Where do I apply for UP Scholarship 2026-27?
faqs.a: Apply online at the official National Scholarship Portal: scholarships.gov.in. There is no offline application.

faqs.q: Is the application fee charged?
faqs.a: No. The scholarship application is free of cost. Beware of agents asking for money.

faqs.q: What documents are required?
faqs.a: Aadhaar, bank account details, income certificate, previous marksheet, category certificate (if applicable) and photo are typically required.

faqs.q: When does the application window open?
faqs.a: The window opens after the state notification each year, typically around July-August. Check the portal for the exact schedule.

posts.title: SSC Document Verification 2026 — Notice for Qualified Candidates
posts.postName: Document Verification for various SSC exams

details: Document verification is the final stage after qualifying the exam
Region-wise schedules published on the official SSC website
Carry all original documents + photocopies as listed in the notice

paras: Candidates must bring original documents along with self-attested photocopies for verification.

faqs.q: Where are SSC document verification notices published?
faqs.a: On the official SSC website (ssc.gov.in) under the respective region (North/West/East/KMPR etc.).

faqs.q: What if I miss my document verification date?
faqs.a: Contact your SSC regional office immediately. Missed verification usually leads to cancellation of candidature.

faqs.q: Are photocopies required?
faqs.a: Yes, carry original documents with self-attested photocopies as mentioned in the notice.
